title: Mad Hatter: indirect poisoned pipeline execution
description: A Jenkins controller builds Wonderland's mad-hatter application repository (hosted on Gitea), but the pipeline's Jenkinsfile lives in a separate, protected repository the attacker cannot modify, so a direct pipeline edit is impossible. The protected pipeline runs `make` inside the application checkout with a release token bound into the build environment. An attacker with write access to the application repo edits its Makefile — the build script the pipeline invokes — to exfiltrate the token in a form the console will not mask, then pushes a branch / opens a pull request to run it (OWASP CICD-SEC-4, Indirect Poisoned Pipeline Execution). Reproduces the "Mad Hatter" challenge from CI/CD Goat.
question: Perform an Indirect-PPE attack against the Wonderland/mad-hatter pipeline by poisoning the Makefile it runs, and exfiltrate the flag3 credential from the Jenkins credential store.
